ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_DONORS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*
** this procedure will do the actual work.
*/
PROCEDURE populate_donors IS
 szDonorID varchar2(10) := :parameter.p_donor_id;
 szChapter varchar2(5) ;--:parameter.p_chapter_id;
 nTotalDonations number;
 nCreditCount number;
 nDeferralCount number;
 nBatchID varchar2(10);
 v_elig_status varchar2(20);
 v_def_date date := null;
 v_inter_type varchar2(20);
 v_reason varchar2(200);
 proc_code varchar2(5);
 don_type varchar2(5);
 v_multi_chap varchar2(5);
BEGIN 
 
 /*select parameter_value into v_multi_chap from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code='MULTI_CHAP' 
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);*/
 
 -- If v_multi_chap ='Y' Then 
 If IS_MULTI_CHAPTER then
 szChapter:='ALL';
 Else
 szChapter:=:global.chapter_id;
 End If;
 
 
 
 
 :donors.donor_id := szDonorID;
 nCreditCount := DON_STD.DONOR_LIFE_CREDIT_COUNT(szDonorID,
 szChapter);
 :total := nCreditCount;
 set_window_property('win_donation',
 title,
 get_window_property('win_donation', title) ||
 ' Total Donation Credits - ' || to_char(nCreditCount));
 :donors.donor_id := szDonorID;
 
 :donors.name := DON_STD.DONOR_NAME(szDonorID, szChapter);--szChapter);
 
 :donors.gender := DON_STD.DONOR_SEX (szDonorID, szChapter);
 
 :donors.date_of_birth := DON_STD.DONOR_DOB (szDonorID, szChapter);
 
 :donors.blood_type := substr(DON_STD.DONOR_ABO (szDonorID, szChapter), 1, 6);
 
 
 
 
BEGIN
 SELECT procedure_code, donation_type
 INTO proc_code, don_type
 FROM donations
 WHERE donor_id = szDonorID
 AND coll_date in (SELECT max(coll_date) FROM donations
 WHERE donor_id = szDonorID
 AND unit_id is not null
 AND chapter_id =:global.chapter_id)-- szChapter)
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id--szChapter
 AND rownum = 1;
 
 
 don_core.CHECK_ELIGIBILITY(szDonorID,proc_code,don_type,sysdate,
 NULL, -- donor weight -- Pkg gets wt from donors if NULL is passed.
 v_elig_status,v_def_date,v_inter_type,v_reason);
 IF v_def_date is null and v_elig_status = 'Y' THEN
 V_def_date := sysdate;
 END IF;
 :next_elig_date := v_def_date; 
 :next_elig_proc := proc_code; 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 null;
 
 END;
 
 go_block('donations');
 :system.message_level:='10';
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level:='0';
 
 go_record(1);
 :donors.coll_date := :donations.coll_date;
 BEGIN
 SELECT batch_id INTO nBatchID
 FROM ( SELECT batch_id
 FROM DONOR_ID_PRINT_DET A
 WHERE exists (SELECT 'x' FROM donor_id_print_det B
 WHERE donor_id = szDonorID
 AND coll_date = :donors.coll_date 
 AND A.batch_id = B.batch_id)
 GROUP by batch_id
 HAVING count(donor_id) = 1 )
 WHERE rownum = 1;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 nBatchID := null;
 
 END;
 :donors.batch_id := nBatchID;
END;

 ------------

---------- 
 IF upper(:print_id) = 'PDF' then
----------

 report_id:= find_report_object('LTREPORTS');

-- Renamed function so that the IS_MULTI_CHAPTER function
-- in the donorlib.pll attached library will be called instead of this
-- Renamed by Kishore on 02/27/2012. IM 7078
FUNCTION IS_MULTI_CHAPTER_OLD RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 V_PARAMETER_VALUE CHAR;

BEGIN
 SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE
 INTO V_PARAMETER_VALUE 
 from VALID_PARAMETERS 
 WHERE PARAMETER_CODE = 'MULTI_CHAP';
 
 IF V_PARAMETER_VALUE = 'Y' THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 ELSE
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 message('no record exists');
 return false;
 when others then
 return false;
 
END;
